name: Shandong Head Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shandong Head Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the production and sales of water-soluble polymer compound series, food additives, and cellulose plant products in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers non-ionic cellulose ethers which provide various cellulose ether products, including hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose (HPMC), hydroxyethyl methyl cellulose, ethyl cellulose, and hydroxyethyl cellulose; and HPMC vegetable capsule, HPMC vegetable capsule, HPMC delay released vegetable capsule, and HPMC enteric vegetable capsule.
